open_blockers.detail: All 137 Maven module POMs were retrieved (133 with a license declaration). The signed APK still defines 16 recognizable Google Play Services classes and four DataTransport classes after shrinking; these are not merely absent/runtime-only Gradle dependencies. Six GMS modules declare Android SDK License terms. File-level terms, actual redistributed Java/native code and GPLv3 compatibility remain unresolved. Fifteen surviving class names match the exact Google Maven base, basement and cronet AARs. Their embedded third-party license lists do not establish terms for the Google client classes. Ten recognizable GMS classes contain 61 method bodies. The standard Google Maven source JAR URLs for the three matched artifacts return HTTP 404. Artifact-specific source and grant are unavailable in the reviewed public evidence.
